name: io.github.tiredofsaas/revu-mcp
title: Revu MCP
description: PDF drawings and markups with Bluebeam Revu 21 on Windows: mark up, stamp, flatten, split, secure.

environmentVariables.name: BLUEBEAM_MCP_FORBIDDEN_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Semicolon-separated directories the server must never read, write or delete.

environmentVariables.name: BLUEBEAM_MCP_READ_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional semicolon-separated allowlist of readable roots.

environmentVariables.name: BLUEBEAM_MCP_WRITE_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional semicolon-separated allowlist of writable roots.

environmentVariables.name: BLUEBEAM_MCP_SCRATCH_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for generated scripts and temporary files.
